H1.rule: falsified if any microservice configuration has significantly lower p99 than A at the lowest load level (two-level bootstrap CI of the p99 ratio, Bonferroni over 6 comparisons)

H2.rule: falsified if A matches or exceeds every microservice configuration at all tested concurrency levels, or if microservice USL fits show beta >= beta_A

H3.rule: falsified if mesh overhead is below 25% of end-to-end latency for call graphs of five or more hops, or if it grows sub-linearly with hop count
